chk.text: Kamigawa is torn by the Kami War, which begins when Lord Konda raids the Spirit World and tears out O-Kagachi's heart, enraging the kami into striking the mortal world.
General Takeno rallies troops at the Battle of Akagi River and warns his men that the kami are coming, while Hisoka advises Konda against a war that cannot be won.
Michiko abandons her father's fortress to consult holy monks and the orochi about the kami's rage, and she meets the thief Toshi Umezawa.

Across the plane, ogres free oni through blood rituals and the Honden of Cleansing Fire's abandoned attendants swarm the land, while in the twentieth year O-Kagachi manifests and devours three thousand warriors.

bok.text: In Kamigawa the Kami War grinds on, with Takeno exhorting his soldiers to rise like the sun and die as heroes, and warriors turning to face O-Kagachi and dying of awe.
Konda grows suspicious that unseen hands manipulate his allies, and Hisoka asks him whether their graves will say they were crushed by their own arrogance.
Toshi, in Michiko's employ and beholden to the Myojin of Night's Reach, tries to honor his commitments, going to the Heart of Frost and later bartering with Night's Reach for teleportation power.
Meanwhile Hidetsugu plans to raze Minamo and Otawara, and Toshi persuades him to attack Jukai first.

sok.text: Near the end of the Kami War the strain upon the veil between worlds begins to show, and the more kami who pass through it, the weaker it becomes.
Michiko Konda leaves home, promising to return only once she can bring her father to his senses and Kamigawa is again at peace.
Toshi, despite avoiding the conflict, becomes the center of the war between the spirit and human realms, and he and Princess Michiko must find a way to stave off the kami's impending victory.
In the end Michiko and Kyodai assume O-Kagachi's role as guardian of the veil and the war ends, though O-Kagachi's death breaks down the barrier and merges the spirit and mortal realms.

m21.text: Kamigawa appears on this set's cards as Azusa's home.

neo.text: Kamigawa is now a plane of kami and technology, brought to peace after the Kami War, where Akki enhancers and the Saiba Futurists spark a technology boom while the Emperor has been missing for ten years.
Tezzeret is sent to Kamigawa, clashes with the Emperor and destabilizes her spark with the Reality Chip, and Tezzeret's Infinite Consortium burns Nashi's village.

Jin-Gitaxias experiments on kami and devises a way to compleat a planeswalker without removing their soul, using it on Tamiyo, while Kaito Shizuki and Tamiyo fight to protect the returned emperor and Kamigawa.
Kairi frees Hidetsugu from the spirit realm to help fight the Phyrexian Invasion, and Hidetsugu agrees.

j22.text: Michiko leaves home, vowing not to return until she can restore her father and bring Kamigawa peace again.
